name: [FIXED 1V1S] JoJo: Golden Records
desc:
Welcome to Golden Records. In this RPG / Action based game you can obtain various stands, fight your enemies, upgrade your stats to get stronger & MORE! Dont forget to join our servers to be notified of updates and development progress.

•Currently this game isn't compatible with Console. A Computer, Phone or a Tablet Device is required to play this game

•JoJo's Bizarre Adventure is owned by Hirohiko Araki. All sounds, stand stuff and various credits goes to their owners!
